name: valve_ep2_holdout
note: Episode Two's holdout from ep2_outland_03, lifted whole with --centroid --keep-nodraw: the built mine gallery from x 3008 west through the control room (door at x 2220) and the narrow corridor on to the top landing (floor about -576; the gallery's clear middle y -10064), the pit (open to Valve's sky, black when placed) with the cage lift down its south wall (holdout_elevator_1: 26 brushes, x 1472..1568, y -9584..-9508, open on its north side, its floor's top flush with the top landing at -512; Valve's path -520 to -1736), the holdout's floor (z -1792; the lift's landing -1728), its two corridors west (cut at x 512, walled up when placed), and north of it the antlion tunnels (blendrockslime) that loop round (the ring x 800..1660, y -7450..-6325) and a chamber east (x 1900..2700) whose tunnel on is cut at Valve's own areaportal frame (x 2872). Box x 300..3008, y -10400..-5750, z -2100..1100. Anchor 2848 -10136 -576: the gallery's floor where it is cut. Holds Valve's 23 grubs in the box (extract keeps them in its wiring). Left out when placed: the story (vortigaunts, scenes, Valve's makers, zombies and antlions, autosaves), the gate the vortigaunt opens (techgate), the control room's door, loose boards and breakables, the areaportal window brushes (func_brush, toolsblack), the tree cards and light beams against the sky, items, weapons, explosive drums. Used by CaveForest.holdout.
